Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Ishaan - 12 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Anita - 39 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Anil - 43 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt

Places

1. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The bedroom - Day

[Ishaan stands in the bedroom. Anita and Anil stand near him.]

Anil: "What lovely weather!"

[Ishaan goes to bed and falls asleep.]

Ishaan: "That's great!"

[Ishaan sits on the edge of the bed.]

Ishaan: "And then?"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Anita stands near him.]

Anita: "Ishaan, look over here."

[Ishaan folds his hands and prays.]

Ishaan (laughing): "Yes, all right."

[Ishaan paints a picture.]

Ishaan: "I'm ready!"

[Ishaan draws a picture of the house.]

Ishaan (softly): "What a day to remember!"
